title: Judge Grants Gilda Lozoya Definitive Suspension Against Agronitrogenados Trial Linkage
detail: Eighth Federal District Judge (Criminal Matters) Rubén Darío Noguera Gregoire granted Gilda Susana Lozoya Austin — sister of former Pemex CEO Emilio Lozoya — a definitive suspension against her formal linkage to trial in the Agronitrogenados money-laundering case, ruling on the amparo she filed August 1, 2026. The court did not make public the scope of the suspension's effects. Lozoya, detained July 1 and linked to trial July 7, 2026 over an alleged $3.4 million transfer tied to Alonso Ancira's bribes in Pemex's overpriced Agronitrogenados plant purchase, remains in provisional liberty. The FGR retains the right to appeal the ruling before a collegiate tribunal; a constitutional hearing on the merits of her amparo is set for September 29, 2026.

media.caption: El Informador: judge grants Gilda Lozoya definitive suspension in Agronitrogenados case
